title: Correction to: Interspecific variation in resistance and tolerance to herbicide drift reveals potential consequences for plant community co-flowering interactions and structure at the agro-eco interface
content: This is a correction to: Veronica Iriart, Regina S Baucom, Tia-Lynn Ashman, Interspecific variation in resistance and tolerance to herbicide drift reveals potential consequences for plant community co-flowering interactions and structure at the agro-eco interface, Annals of Botany, Volume 130, Issue 7, 15 December 2022, Pages 1015–1028, https://doi.org/10.1093/aob/mcac137
